title: First steps
ownerDescription: A few quick steps to set up your company in Flowlio. Do them in any order.
memberDescription: Complete one of your tasks, log your hours and add a profile photo.
evidence: Each step is checked off on its own when you do it.
completed: All done! You can close this list.
error: Could not hide the checklist. Try again.
managerDescription: Add a client, create a project and add its first task.
currencyDescription: Choose the currency your organization uses before creating financial records. It is independent of language and never converts existing amounts.
currencyReady: Organization currency saved. You can continue with your next steps.
step_create_task: Add a task to a project
